svg.text: Every macroblock of the edited frame, compared with the camera’s picture
One cell = one 16×16 macroblock. 80 across × 45 down = 3,600 cells. Colour says what happened to that block.
Camera clip WITH the smoothing filter
3,521 of 3,600 blocks are bit-identical to the camera
untouched, left exactly as the camera wrote it
stored raw, decodes to the camera’s pixels
stored raw, still differs from the camera
